title: 第23章乌雀撞柱老猫叫门第24章诡事不急教学为先
slug: 我的民俗游戏机第227章权限
content_zh:
怒斥完毕，许峰在社庙四角依次“放饭”。
安顿四方游魂，这才回头关上大门！
这个时候，师父也已经准备好了。
虽然说这许多事情都叫许峰做，可师父也不放心，他还是抽空看了两眼许峰，看到徒弟如此争气。
十分欣慰。
说道：“不错，有我三分本事了！”
他脸上在此刻难得地露出了一丝笑意，说道：“本事基础都有了，现在需要的，只是再度打磨了。”
许峰就看到师父将某一物，缝在了自己的衣服上。
就像是文臣武将的衣冠禽兽补子一样。
见此，许峰心中一动。
他没去问这“补子”是甚么，因为这几天的接触下来，他也懂得“察言观色”。
知道在现今这种情况之下。
是问不到结果的。
至于问游戏，游戏也不回答，除非许峰上手去摸，是道具的话，可能会有提示。
可是看现在师父的样子，许峰不想上前去减好感度。
至于师父所说的“三分本事”。
自己最好能有师父的三分本事。
要是再少些，也能接受，因为自己本事越小，就证明师父本事越大！
说话之间，师父将一个巨大包裹，还有几个细小褡裢，递给了许峰。
二人来到了西房的门前，师父又在石雕上面抹“血”，插草，最后更是将一炷香插在了石雕前头。

这才说道：“和我来罢！”
这次，他也不拿火折子，转而直接拿火把。
也不叫许峰在前面，而是自己在前面。
将那门打开之后，他人不进去，只是将火把放进去！
就是一下！
“呼”的一声，哪怕是在师父后头，许峰也听得极其清楚。
就像是有人在屋子里面，憋下来自己的嘴巴，用力的对着火把吹了一口气。
刹那之间，那松油火把，由红转绿，到了最后，竟然真个被吹灭了。
就在这一闪而逝的瞬间，许峰甚至看到了一张脸！
难以形容的一张脸，可是还不等许峰大脑动转，师父动作比他的思绪还要快。
先是香灰扬起，应该还有别的动作。
许峰没看到，但是那一张脸哀嚎一声，立刻往回退走！
content_en:
After finishing his angry rebuke, Xu Feng "placed rice" in the four corners of the temple.
After settling the wandering souls from all directions, we turned back and closed the door!
At this time, the master was also ready.
Although Xu Feng was asked to do many of these things, the master was not at ease. He still took the time to look at Xu Feng and saw that his apprentice was so up to date.
Very pleased.
Said: "Yes, you have three of my abilities!"
A rare smile appeared on his face at this moment, and he said: "I have the basics of my skills. What I need now is just to polish them again."
Xu Feng saw his master sewing something onto his clothes.
Just like the clothes of civil servants and military generals.
Seeing this, Xu Feng's heart moved.
He didn't ask what this "complement" was, because after these few days of contact, he also knew how to "observe words and emotions."
I know that under current circumstances.
There is no way to ask for the result.
As for asking the game, the game will not answer, unless Xu Feng touches it. If it is a prop, there may be a prompt.
But looking at his master's appearance now, Xu Feng didn't want to go forward and reduce his favorability.
As for the "three points of ability" mentioned by Master.
It is best for you to have the three-point ability of your master.
If it's less, I can accept it, because the less capable I am, it proves that the master is more capable!
While speaking, the master handed a huge package and several small robes to Xu Feng.
The two came to the door of the west room, and the master smeared "blood" on the stone sculpture, inserted grass, and finally inserted a stick of incense in front of the stone sculpture.
Then he said: "Come with me!"
This time, he didn't take the fire stick, but directly took the torch.
He didn't ask Xu Feng to be in front, but he was in front.
After opening the door, others don't go in, they just put the torch in!
Just for a moment!
Xu Feng heard the "whoop" sound very clearly even from behind his master.
It was as if someone was inside the house, holding back his mouth and blowing hard on the torch.
In an instant, the pine oil torch turned from red to green, and in the end, it was actually blown out.
In this fleeting moment, Xu Feng even saw a face!
An indescribable face, but before Xu Feng could think about it, the master's movements were faster than his thoughts.
First the incense ashes were raised, and there should be other movements.
Xu Feng didn't see it, but the face wailed and immediately stepped back!
